title: Uniform error of the mollification of a globally Lipschitz function: |ρ⋆F − F| ≤ Lσ (parent Step 6)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and L ≥ 0, and let F : ℝ^P → ℝ satisfy |F(a) − F(b)| ≤ L|a − b| for all a, b ∈ ℝ^P. Let σ ∈ ℝ, and let ρ : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with compact support such that ρ(y) ≥ 0 for all y, ρ(y) = 0 whenever |y| ≥ σ, and ∫ρ dλ^P = 1. Then for every x ∈ ℝ^P, |∫ ρ(y)F(x − y) dλ^P(y) − F(x)| ≤ Lσ. Here λ^P is Lebesgue measure (`volume` on `Eucl P`).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L F → ∀ (ρ : Eucl P → ℝ) (σ : ℝ), Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ρ y) → (∀ y : Eucl P, σ ≤ ‖y‖ → ρ y = 0) → ∫ y, ρ y = 1 → ∀ x : Eucl P, |(∫ y, ρ y * F (x - y)) - F x| ≤ (L : ℝ) * σ
